title: Entry and exit criteria for a test cycle

videos.script: Two days of testing before Friday's release. When can they start, and when are they done? Decide both on Monday, while nobody is in a hurry. {{monday}} Entry criteria first. Every change in one build. A smoke test that passes. The right machine, the right data. Without them, testing starts on a build that will have to be tested again. {{entry}} Then exit criteria. Every area got its hours, or the shortfall is written down. The agreed examples pass. No serious defect open in prices, orders or refunds. And a list of what was not tested. {{exit}} If a blocking defect appears, testing stops, and a three-line message says what happened, what is done, and what ready means. {{suspend}} On Friday, Lia reports each criterion, met or not met. Joana decides. A criterion not met does not forbid a release. It means the person who decides must decide knowingly. {{end}}
